clue.text: Succeeded with a spot of moving flattery

parts.note: S is the standard abbreviation for succeeded, as in family trees

indicators.note: moving here means the letters of the words are stirred about into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone is won over by a little touching sweet talk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moving' looks like 'touching' but signals rearranging A SPOT OF into OFTSOAP, placed after S.
explanation.definitionFit: Soft soap is an idiom for smooth persuasive praise, i.e. flattery used to win someone over.

clue.text: Trying experience in gold trade

parts.note: or is gold in heraldry
a deal is a trade or transaction

explanation.surface: A rough time dealing in gold.
explanation.definitionFit: An ordeal is a painful or difficult experience that tests someone.

clue.text: Food: tons ready to be harvested

parts.note: a crop that is ripe is ready for picking

explanation.surface: Masses of produce ready to be gathered.
explanation.definitionFit: Tripe, the stomach lining of cattle, is eaten as food.

clue.text: Too quick a shot, very ungainly

indicators.note: ungainly means clumsy and awkward, so the letters of the words are jumbled

explanation.surface: A rushed shot that was very clumsy.
explanation.definitionFit: Overhasty means acting with excessive speed, rushing without enough thought.

clue.text: Rabbit, soft baby's toy

parts.note: P, piano, is the musical marking for soft
a rattle is a toy for babies

explanation.surface: A cuddly rabbit sits beside a baby's plaything.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rabbit' is a verb: in British slang to rabbit (on) is to talk at length, from rhyming slang 'rabbit and pork' for talk.
explanation.definitionFit: To rabbit is British slang for chattering on; to prattle is to chatter idly.

clue.text: Blunt, independent married couple

parts.note: I is the usual abbreviation for independent, as in politics
a couple is a pair

explanation.surface: A self-reliant married twosome described as outspoken.
explanation.definitionFit: To blunt something is to weaken or dull it, a verb synonym of damage or lessen.

clue.text: Place under batting data

indicators.note: in a down clue, putting one word under another places it after

parts.note: in cricket the side batting is in
to place is to put

explanation.surface: A cricket statistician's records, placed beneath the batting figures.
explanation.definitionFit: Input is information fed into a system, a synonym of data.

clue.text: Posers for supply teacher

indicators.note: read as 'supply' (supplely), meaning in a flexible way, so the letters are bent into a new order

explanation.surface: Tricky questions for a supply teacher filling in at school.
explanation.walkthrough: 'supply teacher' looks like a single phrase; split it, and 'supply' is read as an adverb from supple, signalling the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: A professor is a senior university teacher.

clue.text: Depression following popular Channel Islands event

indicators.note: following means the hollow comes after the other pieces

parts.note: in means popular or fashionable
a dent is a depression or hollow

explanation.surface: A hollow appearing after a popular happening in the Channel Islands.
explanation.definitionFit: An incident is an occurrence or happening, a synonym of event.

clue.text: Take one's hat off to daughter entering a stretch of boggy ground

indicators.note: entering means the daughter's letter goes into the middle of the other pieces

parts.note: a mire is a swamp or bog

explanation.surface: Respect for a daughter who wades into a bog.
explanation.definitionFit: Taking one's hat off to someone is an idiom for showing respect and esteem.

clue.text: Method that may get a fish very quietly hooked

indicators.note: hooked means caught and held inside, so the musical letters are taken in by the other pieces

parts.note: a roach is a freshwater fish
PP, pianissimo, is the musical marking for very quietly

explanation.surface: A technique for silently landing a fish on the line.
explanation.definitionFit: An approach is a way of dealing with something, a synonym of a method or technique.

clue.text: Exclamation made by one hitting another in pop group?

definitions.text: Exclamation made by one hitting another
definitions.meaning: the cry accompanying a blow, as in 'have this!'
a British boy band of the 1990s onwards with Gary Barlow and Robbie Williams

explanation.surface: A puzzling case of violence among members of a band.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is both a triumphant cry when landing a blow and the name of a famous British boy band.

clue.text: Hear about object, very fashionable

indicators.note: about means the first piece goes around the second

parts.note: to hear a case in court is to try it
an end is an aim or object, as in 'to that end'

explanation.surface: An instruction to listen to some thing deemed highly stylish.
explanation.definitionFit: Trendy is a colloquial synonym of up to date or modish in style.

clue.text: Inaccurately portray reformed miser here

indicators.note: reformed means formed anew, so the letters of miser are rearranged

parts.note: present means here, in attendance

explanation.surface: A Scrooge-like miser who has mended his ways is shown in a false light.
explanation.definitionFit: To give a false or misleading account of something is to distort or falsify it.

clue.text: Made light of notes describing one newspaper chief

indicators.note: describing in its sense of drawing around, so the notes enclose the numeral

parts.note: minims are musical notes, half notes
I is the Roman numeral one
ED is short for editor

explanation.surface: An editor's note-taking played down.
explanation.definitionFit: To make light of something is to play it down or belittle its importance.

clue.text: Dog, barking terrier, biting vet endlessly

indicators.note: biting means the scrambled breed holds the vet's letters within it
barking is British slang for mad, so the letters of terrier go wild
endlessly means the last letter of the word vet is lost

explanation.surface: A yapping terrier bites the vet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'barking' reads as the dog's noise but is British slang for mad, signalling the anagram; 'Dog' at the start is the definition, not the terrier.
explanation.definitionFit: A retriever is a gun-dog breed, such as a Labrador or golden.

clue.text: Manage after hearing test

indicators.note: after means the word for manage comes behind the court hearing

parts.note: a trial is a court hearing
to run a business is to manage it

explanation.surface: Coping once a hearing test is done.
explanation.definitionFit: A trial run is a practice rehearsal or test of how something works.

clue.text: Sauce on heat in B&B, say

indicators.note: in means the lustful word is placed between the two letters

parts.note: B&B (bed and breakfast) supplies its two B letters
randy means lustful, like an animal on heat
to utter is to say

explanation.surface: A saucy goings-on at a bed and breakfast, or a sauce served there.
explanation.walkthrough: B&B, a British bed-and-breakfast guesthouse, is just two Bs here, with RANDY between them. The answer is a rich Christmas-pudding sauce.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a sweet hard sauce of butter, sugar and spirits served with Christmas pudding.

clue.text: Ready to take part on horseback, on account of Italian

parts.note: a jockey riding is said to be up
for means because of, as in 'for that reason'
IT is short for Italian, as in Italian vermouth

explanation.surface: A keen Italian rider keen to join in.
explanation.definitionFit: Up for it is an idiom for being willing and eager to do something.

clue.text: Musical piece, likewise with a beat, coming up

parts.note: so means likewise, as in 'so do I'

indicators.note: in a down clue coming up means read from bottom to top, so backwards

parts.note: to tan someone is to beat them

explanation.surface: A composition rising with a rhythm.
explanation.definitionFit: A sonata is a classical composition for one or two instruments.

clue.text: Comic book crimefighter, officer's personal assistant

definitions.meaning: the caped DC Comics hero of Gotham City
an army officer's servant or orderly

explanation.surface: A superhero who doubles as someone's aide.
explanation.definitionFit: The DC superhero shares his name with the old military term for an officer's orderly.

clue.text: Illustrious person of wealth, extremely likeable

parts.note: a nob is slang for a rich or upper-class person

indicators.note: extremely means the two extreme letters of the word likeable

explanation.surface: A famous, very pleasant rich person.
explanation.definitionFit: Noble means distinguished and of high rank, close to illustrious.

clue.text: Invented story about Republican causes conflict

indicators.note: about means the invented story goes around the party letter

parts.note: fiction is invented narrative

explanation.surface: A political fabrication about a Republican stirs up strife.
explanation.definitionFit: Friction is discord or clashing between people, a synonym of conflict.

clue.text: Livener kept in bucket, on ice

indicators.note: kept in means the letters are held within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A pick-me-up drink chilling in an ice bucket.
explanation.definitionFit: A tonic is something that invigorates or revives, a pick-me-up.

clue.text: Part of the woodwork in pub by bridge

parts.note: to bridge is to cross
a bar is a pub

explanation.surface: Some carpentry found in a pub beside a bridge.
explanation.walkthrough: In football, 'the woodwork' is the goalposts and the bar across them.
explanation.definitionFit: In football slang the woodwork is the goal frame, of which the horizontal top beam is one part.

clue.text: One doing wilful damage in museum close to Whitehall

parts.note: the V and A is the Victoria and Albert Museum in London

indicators.note: close to means the final letter of the word Whitehall

explanation.surface: A wrecker at a museum near Whitehall, London's government district.
explanation.definitionFit: A vandal deliberately destroys or defaces property.

clue.text: Ill at ease concerning border

parts.note: on means concerning, as in a talk on art
an edge is a border

explanation.surface: Someone feeling nervous about a boundary.
explanation.definitionFit: Being on edge is an idiom for being tense and nervous.

clue.text: Go off and film rat

parts.note: milk that goes off is said to turn
a film is a thin layer or coat

explanation.surface: Instructions to leave and shoot a movie of a rodent.
explanation.definitionFit: A rat is slang for a traitor or deserter who switches sides.
